info.title: Temple Raids API
info.description: External API for Temple guild raid management

BearerToken.description: Personal API token generated from your profile page

firstRaidAt.description: ISO date of earliest attended raid

lastRaidAt.description: ISO date of most recent attended raid

secondaryIds.description: Character IDs to set as secondaries

mode.description: replace: clears existing secondaries and sets new list. append: merges with existing secondaries.
addNewSignupsToBench: adds new signups as benched, never removes existing. fullReimport: replaces roster completely.

id.description: Character ID. null for ambiguous matches where the exact character is uncertain.

status.description: Raid Helper signup status: Confirmed, Bench, Tentative, Late, Absence, Absent

matchStatus.description: matched: linked to a DB character. ambiguous: best-guess family found. unmatched: no match. skipped: non-WoW-class signup (Bench, Absent, etc).

resolvedId.description: Actual event instance ID after recurring-event resolution. Equal to id when not a recurring event.

encounterId.description: null = plan-level default slot; uuid = encounter-specific slot

get.description: Search and list guild characters. Excludes ignored characters. Results capped at 200.

schema.description: Filter by character type. Defaults to all.

parameters.description: Filter by character type. Defaults to all.
parameters.name: type

schema.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to name.

parameters.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to name.
parameters.name: sortBy

get.description: Looks up multiple characters by exact name. Matching is case-insensitive and diacritic-insensitive (e.g. `Grolnakh` matches `Grólnakh`). Names that don't match any character are silently omitted. Capped at 100 names per request.
Returns character by ID. Ignored characters can be retrieved by ID even though they are excluded from the list endpoint.
Returns 6-week rolling attendance for a character's primary family. Resolves secondary characters to their primary automatically.
Returns the authenticated user's profile and linked character (if any)

patch.description: Enable or disable the Templar Discord bot from acting on your behalf via the admin proxy.

403.description: Forbidden — requires raid manager or admin role

get.description: Returns the OpenAPI 3.0 specification for the Temple Raids API

put.description: Sets secondary characters for a primary. Requires isRaidManager. Mode 'replace' (default) clears all existing secondaries and sets the new list. Mode 'append' merges incoming IDs with existing secondaries (deduped).

400.description: Invalid input, character is not a primary, or secondaryIds includes primaryId

403.description: Not a raid manager or admin

delete.description: Removes a character from its primary family, making it standalone. Requires isRaidManager.

200.description: Character successfully unlinked from its primary

400.description: Character is not a secondary — standalone characters and primary characters cannot be unlinked

403.description: Not a raid manager or admin

get.summary: Get signups for a scheduled event
get.description: Fetches Raid Helper signups for a given event, matches each to a DB character, and inlines 6-week attendance. Returns all signups regardless of status — use matchStatus to filter. Handles recurring events automatically. Requires isRaidManager.

200.description: Event signups with character matching and attendance

404.description: Event not found in Raid Helper

get.description: Lists upcoming Discord events from Raid Helper, annotated with whether a raid plan exists. Requires isRaidManager.

schema.description: Include events that started up to N hours ago. Defaults to 0.

parameters.description: Include events that started up to N hours ago. Defaults to 0.
parameters.name: hoursBack

200.description: List of upcoming events sorted by startTime ascending

get.description: Returns recent raid plans sorted by last-modified descending. Thin list — no roster or encounter detail. Requires isRaidManager.

schema.description: Number of plans to return. Default 20, max 50.

parameters.description: Number of plans to return. Default 20, max 50.
parameters.name: limit

post.description: Creates a new raid plan shell for a Raid Helper event. Applies encounter structure from cloneFromPlanId (if provided) or from the active raid template. Roster is empty — use sync-signups after creation. Returns 409 if a plan already exists for the event. Requires isRaidManager.

409.description: Plan already exists for this event

get.description: Plan detail. Metadata and roster (characters) are always returned. Use `?include=` to request additional sections: encounterGroups, encounters, encounterAssignments, aaSlots. Requires isRaidManager.

schema.description: Optional sections to include beyond the default roster. encounterAssignments and aaSlots implicitly resolve encounters for ID lookups.

parameters.description: Optional sections to include beyond the default roster. encounterAssignments and aaSlots implicitly resolve encounters for ID lookups.
parameters.name: include

200.description: Plan metadata plus any requested sections. Section arrays are absent when not requested.

patch.description: Updates the plan-level default AA template and/or the useDefaultAA flag. All fields are optional — only provided fields are updated. Requires isRaidManager.

400.description: Invalid plan ID or request body

delete.description: Permanently deletes a raid plan and all associated roster, encounters, and AA slot data. Requires isRaidManager.

post.description: Fetches current signups from Raid Helper and refreshes the plan roster. addNewSignupsToBench (default) adds new signups as benched characters without removing existing. fullReimport replaces the roster completely and resets all custom encounter groups. Requires isRaidManager.

400.description: Plan has no linked Raid Helper event, or invalid plan ID

put.description: Bulk-patches defaultGroup/defaultPosition for multiple characters in a single transaction. Characters not listed are untouched. IDs not belonging to this plan are silently skipped. Requires isRaidManager.

patch.summary: Re-link roster slot to a DB character
patch.description: Updates the character link on a single roster slot. Use to resolve an ambiguous signup match — bind a write-in to a specific DB character. Requires isRaidManager.

404.description: Plan or roster slot not found

put.description: Partial update for a single encounter. When aaTemplate changes, orphaned AA slot assignments are removed. When useDefaultGroups transitions true→false, seeds encounter assignments from current default groups if none exist yet. Requires isRaidManager.

400.description: No fields provided, or validation error

404.description: Encounter not found or does not belong to this plan

put.description: Bulk-patches per-encounter group assignments. Upserts by (encounterId, planCharacterId) — update if row exists, insert otherwise. Only applies when useDefaultGroups=false on the encounter. Requires isRaidManager.

404.description: Encounter not found or does not belong to this plan

put.summary: Bulk assign characters to AA slots
put.description: Merge semantics: upserts by (slotName, encounterId, planCharacterId). Slots not mentioned are untouched. encounterId=null means plan-level default AA slot. Runs serially to preserve sortOrder correctness. Requires isRaidManager.

200.description: Counts of assigned and skipped slots

get.description: Returns all hardcoded raid zones with their template configuration. Zones without a configured template return template: null. Requires isRaidManager.
Returns full raid template detail including encounters and encounter groups. Returns template: null if zone exists but has no template yet. Requires isRaidManager.

patch.description: Updates isActive and/or defaultAATemplate. Auto-creates the template record if it does not exist. Requires isRaidManager.

post.description: Adds a new encounter preset. Auto-creates the raid template record if needed. sortOrder is appended after the current max. Requires isRaidManager.

put.description: Updates any combination of encounterName, aaTemplate, sortOrder, groupId. Regenerates encounterKey when encounterName changes. Requires isRaidManager.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the encounter preset. Requires isRaidManager.

post.description: Atomically updates sort orders for groups and encounters, and reassigns encounter groupId values. Both arrays are optional but at least one item must be provided. Requires isRaidManager.

post.summary: Create encounter group in raid template
post.description: Creates a new encounter group. sortOrder is appended after the current max across both encounters and groups. Auto-creates the raid template record if needed. Requires isRaidManager.

put.description: Updates the group name. Requires isRaidManager.

delete.description: Deletes a group. mode=promote (default) moves child encounters to top-level; mode=deleteChildren deletes them. Requires isRaidManager.

get.description: List raids newest-first, with optional zone/date-range/scored filters.

post.description: Creates a raid, optionally attaching existing WCL logs and bench characters. Requires isRaidManager.

get.description: Raid detail. logs and bench are always returned. Use `?include=attendees` to also return the full roster of characters who attended any attached log.

patch.description: Updates raid fields and/or reassigns which WCL logs are attached to this raid. All fields optional. Requires isRaidManager.

400.description: Invalid raid ID, request body, or no fields provided

delete.description: Permanently deletes a raid. Attached WCL logs are detached, not deleted. Requires isRaidManager.

put.description: Fully replaces the raid's bench roster with the given character IDs. Requires isRaidManager.

400.description: Invalid raid ID or request body

post.description: Re-fetches every WCL log attached to this raid from the WarcraftLogs API and updates kills, participants, and attendee mappings. Useful when a log link was imported before the raid finished and was never refreshed. Requires isRaidManager.
